description: This file defines data models, query parameters, and fetcher logic for retrieving Fama-French country portfolio returns data, including data transformation and metadata handling.

classes.name: FamaFrenchCountryPortfolioReturnsQueryParams
classes.description: Defines query parameters for fetching country portfolio returns, including country, measure, frequency, dividends, data completeness, and date range.

classes.name: FamaFrenchCountryPortfolioReturnsData
classes.description: Represents the structure of the returned portfolio returns data, including various financial ratios and metadata.

classes.name: FamaFrenchCountryPortfolioReturnsFetcher
classes.description: Handles fetching and transforming Fama-French country portfolio returns data asynchronously.

methods.name: transform_query
methods.description: Converts a dictionary of parameters into a strongly typed query parameter object.

methods.name: aextract_data
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches data from the Fama-French FTP, with warnings for unsupported measure-frequency combinations.

methods.name: transform_data
methods.description: Processes raw data and metadata, cleans no-data columns, filters by date, and constructs detailed descriptions.
